doc.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012

title: Shamanism, filming the Shuar in Ecuador, and his uncle
summary: He explains his interest in shamans and healers, filming the Shuar, and his uncle Burrill B. Crohn.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And not just jazz films. I saw on your web site —
I saw a picture of you in Ecuador? In the jungle?

Well I happen to have a big interest in shamanism. And so I’ve done research in that area and ah blah-blah-blah. I’ve shot shamans in different countries. And that particular thing was some people I knew were going down to make a recording of the music and dance of the Shuars. See that picture over there of the guy with the painted face and everything? That’s a Shuar, they’re an indigenous tribe of Ecuador in the rain forest. And they have their own — I’ll give you a CD — they have their music which is — their songs are all sacred. They have songs for planting, songs for hunting, songs for fishing. Icaros I think is the term, that forms a prayer before they do any activity. So I went down to film the making of this CD, which was their songs. And I’ve shot shamans in different parts of the world and stuff like that. This is a whole other interest of mine — spiritual things, healers, I’m very interested in healers because I think they are the medicine of the future. They’re the medicine of the past and the medicine of the future. Even pharmaceutical companies go in the rain forest to rob the plants and patent the compounds and we use them as this great medication. I’m so sorry.
It’s an interesting outlook. Because I know you have medical — your uncle was very well known, right?

My name is Burrill L. Crohn and my uncle’s name was Burrill B. Crohn, and he is the — not the inventor but he correctly identified the cluster of symptoms as being misdiagnosed as Crohn’s disease. And so yeah, so I bear that name, which is interesting. There is a connection there somehow. Everyone thought I should be a doctor and I wasn’t interested, but I am interested in healing. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
